brief: Before and after switching from Notion to Linear: what changed, what didn't, what we regret.

slots.title: Stop managing
slots.description: We ditched Notion for Linear. Here's what improved, what stayed the same, and what we actually regret.

slots.title: Projects got
slots.description: Notion flexed for everything but broke under speed. Linear gave us structure without the bloat.
slots.badText: Roadmaps lived in tables that someone forgot to update every Monday.
slots.goodText: Cycles auto-populate and everyone sees blockers in real time.

slots.title: Ownership turned
slots.description: In Notion, anyone could edit. In Linear, someone is always assigned. No more ghost tasks.
slots.badText: Tasks floated in docs with no assignee and zero urgency.
slots.goodText: Every issue has an owner, a cycle, and a clear priority.

slots.title: Speed won
slots.description: Keyboard shortcuts and cmd+k made Linear feel like a dev tool. Notion felt like a CMS.
slots.badText: Clicking through nested pages just to mark a task done.
slots.goodText: One shortcut creates, assigns, and moves an issue to in-progress.

slots.title: Docs still
slots.description: Linear replaced our roadmap, not our wiki. We regret trying to move everything.
slots.badText: We tried to write long-form specs inside Linear issues.
slots.goodText: We admitted Notion wins for docs and kept it alongside.

slots.title: Adoption still
slots.description: Linear is opinionated. The team resisted for two weeks. Change is never instant.
slots.badText: Notion was messy but the whole team already knew where to click.
slots.goodText: Linear forced new habits and managers had to retrain everyone.

slots.title: Insights finally
slots.description: Notion had no analytics. Linear shows cycle velocity, backlog growth, and real capacity.
slots.badText: We guessed progress based on who updated a checkbox last.
slots.goodText: Dashboards reveal exactly where work stalls and who is blocked.

slots.body: Start your free trial and see why fast teams choose Linear over wiki bloat.
